l1: Are there specific domain controllers reporting replication errors?
When did the replication failure symptoms first begin occurring?
Is the replication issue happening intra-site or inter-site?
Are there any recent changes to the Active Directory schema or configuration?
Total number of domain controllers in the forest and their OS versions?
l2: Have there been recent changes to the network topology or firewalls between sites?
Are there any lingering objects or USN rollback indications in the event logs?
Is the KCC (Knowledge Consistency Checker) failing to generate the replication topology?
Are there any DNS resolution issues between the domain controllers?
Are there any errors in the Directory Service event log related to replication (Event IDs 1311, 1865, 1925, 1566)?
Are there any issues with the SYSVOL share or DFSR replication?
Are there any issues with the secure channel between domain controllers?
Are there any issues with the RPC service or ports required for replication?

l1: Check the events and conclude are they related to Topology or Replication failures using Event Viewer on the affected DCs.
Run 'dcdiag /test:replications /v' on the affected Domain Controller.
Run 'repadmin /showrepl' on the affected Domain Controller.
Run 'repadmin /replsummary' to check the overall replication health status.
Check the Directory Service event log for Event IDs 1311, 1864, or 1925.
l2: Run 'repadmin /showvector <naming_context>' to check the highest USN vectors.
Run 'dcdiag /test:replications /v' for a verbose replication diagnostics check.
Use 'repadmin /queue' to see if there are backed-up replication tasks.

l1: Verify DNS resolution between the source and destination domain controllers.
Verify that RPC services and NetBIOS names are reachable across the DCs.
l2: Fix Lingering Objects using 'repadmin /removelingeringobjects' if error 8606 is present.
Reset the secure channel between domain controllers using 'nltest /sc_reset:<domain>'.
Rebuild the SYSVOL share using DFSR authoritatively or non-authoritatively if out of sync.

l1: Export the complete Directory Service event log to a .evtx file.
Run 'repadmin /showrepl * /csv > showrepl_all.csv' to capture full topology states.
Collect the output of 'ipconfig /all' and 'dcdiag /test:dns' from affected DCs.
l2: Capture a network trace using Wireshark or Netmon during a forced replication attempt.
Export the Active Directory configuration partition registry settings for replication.
Enable verbose diagnostic logging for KCC and Replication via registry keys under NTDS\Diagnostics.

rpc_server_unavailable.title: Active Directory Replication fails with 'RPC Server Unavailable' (Error 1722)

steps.expect: Look for error string 'The RPC server is unavailable' or error code 1722
Should succeed; if it fails, DNS or network connectivity is broken
Port 135 (RPC Endpoint Mapper) must report LISTENING
Ensure RPC service is started, or unblock required AD ports on the intervening firewall
Syncall terminates without errors, and subsequent repadmin /showrepl displays Successful status

replication_access_denied.title: Active Directory Replication fails with 'Replication Access Was Denied'

steps.action: Check UserAccountControl attribute on destination DC computer account
steps.expect: SERVER_TRUST_ACCOUNT or TRUSTED_FOR_DELEGATION flags must be present

steps.action: Review default permissions on directory partitions
steps.expect: Scheduled replication must be allowed under OS security context

steps.action: Validate permissions on directory partitions for ad-hoc replication
steps.expect: Users must have rights for 'replicate now', 'repadmin /replicate', 'repadmin /syncall'

steps.action: Check user membership in replication-related security groups
steps.expect: User must belong to groups granted 'Replicating Directory Changes' permission

steps.action: Evaluate User Account Control (UAC) split token behavior
steps.expect: UAC may remove replication group membership from user's security token

steps.action: Correct UserAccountControl flags on DC computer account
steps.expect: Ensure SERVER_TRUST_ACCOUNT or TRUSTED_FOR_DELEGATION is set

steps.action: Restore default or custom permissions on affected directory partitions
steps.expect: Scheduled and ad-hoc replication should succeed

steps.action: Run RODCPREP if destination DC is an RODC
steps.expect: Enterprise Read-Only Domain Controllers group must have Replicate Directory Changes permission

steps.action: Review forest for legacy Office Communications Server installations
steps.expect: Newer OS version DCs may fail replication until OCS-related schema/permissions are corrected
